traits.name: Absorb
traits.text: ⭓ (death, divine, necromancy); Trigger The warsworn moves into a dying creature's space. Effect The warsworn absorbs the dying creature into itself, instantly killing the creature and healing the warsworn for a number of Hit Points equal to the creature's level. As long as the warsworn still exists, absorbed creatures can't be resurrected except by wish or a similarly powerful effect.

traits.name: Animated Weapons
traits.text: (divine, evocation); The warsworn assumes control of unattended weapons within 100 feet, forcing them to levitate around it. The warsworn can telekinetically wield these weapons to make melee Strikes with a reach of 100 feet.

traits.name: Energy Drain
traits.text: (divine, necromancy); When a warsworn hits with a corpse wave Strike or damages a creature with Trample, the target must succeed at a DC 35 Fortitude save or become drained 2 and doomed 1. On a critical success, the target becomes temporarily immune to the warsworn's energy drain for 24 hours.

traits.name: Plummet
traits.text: A creature hit by a warsworn's scrap ball Strike must attempt a DC 37 Reflex save. On a failure, the target falls prone; if the target was airborne, it falls up to 120 feet, taking damage from the fall and landing prone if the descent brings it to the ground. On a critical failure, the target is also held under a pile of scrap (DC 37 to Escape).

traits.name: Trample
traits.text: ⬽ Huge or smaller, corpse wave, DC 37.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ corpse wave +32 (magical); Damage 4d12+9 (4d12+9) bludgeoning plus energy drain

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ animated weapon +30 (agile, magical, reach 100 feet, versatile b, versatile p); Damage four of the weapon's damage dice +9 of the weapon's damage type

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ scrap ball +28 (magical, range increment 100 feet); Damage 4d12+9 (4d12+9) bludgeoning plus plummet
